basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old automotive enthusiast from San Diego, California. I've always had a passion for Japanese sports cars, especially the Nissan 300ZX, which I own and love to tinker with. When I'm not under the hood, I work as a freelance graphic designer. I enjoy listening to podcasts, particularly the Joe Budden Podcast, and I have a keen interest in learning butchery as a hobby. I'm single and typically active on Reddit late evenings after work, usually around 9 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of automotive mechanics, mostly self-taught through years of maintaining and upgrading my cars. I often refer to online resources, forums, and YouTube tutorials to expand my knowledge. Additionally, my graphic design skills stem from a degree in visual arts and over a decade of freelance work.
